title: job_ref
description: Output of 01_INGEST: the record of the file that entered the job. Contract proposal: docs/job-ref-contract-proposal.md (decisions of Fonseca, 2026-11-07; the H1 job-entry contract is treated as nonexistent). It holds facts of the file only: source_origin and input_context are columns of editorial.jobs, paper metadata has no consumer yet, and the page texts live elsewhere.

job_id.description: editorial.jobs.id; existence is checked by code

model.description: model name, or not_reported when the stage used no LLM

created_at.description: ISO 8601 in UTC, with the Z suffix

file_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the received file, in lowercase hexadecimal; computed by the 01_INGEST stage, so two jobs that processed the same file can be told apart from two that did not

page_count.description: number of pages of the file; it must equal the number of page texts stored for the job, the list that validators/citation.js receives (checked by code)

media_type.description: closed list: the MVP accepts only PDF (decision of Fonseca, 2026-11-07). Another type needs a way to extract text by page, which has no source yet
